name: Wisconsin Steel Fabrication LLC
old_description: Wisconsin Steel Fabrication LLC is a steel fabrication and manufacturing company in Omro, Wisconsin. We handle everything from large modular and  construction projects all the way down to small repair work and support members for residential projects. We are a family business run by two brothers born and raised in Berlin WI. Since our inception in a small 900 sq ft, back yard garage with just a few welders, and a small forklift, we have proven that no job is too big or too small for us to be able to tackle. We now have grown to a 12 acre, 25,000 square ft facility with cutting edge equipment and experienced staff. We pride ourselves on Quality and on time delivery. Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us, after all without the customer you do not have a business. Bring us any project or idea and we will find a way to help you make it happen!
about:
Wisconsin Steel Fabrication LLC operates from Omro, Wisconsin, where it began as a family venture started by two brothers raised in nearby Berlin. The company traces its roots to a 900-square-foot backyard garage equipped with a handful of welders and a small forklift, growing from that modest start into a 12-acre campus encompassing 25,000 square feet of production space.

The shop provides steel fabrication and manufacturing services spanning large modular fabrication, small modular fabrication, structural steel, custom fabrication, railings and stairs, and certified welding. Its capabilities cover projects ranging from sizable modular and construction builds down to repair work and support members for residential jobs, all executed within the expanded facility.

Customers come from the construction sector, modular building projects, and residential markets, with the company positioning itself to handle both large-scale commercial modules and smaller residential repair tasks.

The founders emphasize quality and on-time delivery as core differentiators, stating that customer satisfaction drives the business and that they will find a way to make any project or idea happen.
